aboutDoctor.name: Dr. Shabnam Sorooshiani
aboutDoctor.bio:
Dr. Shabnam Sorooshiani has always been passionate about the well being of her community, particularly public health of her community. In 2019, she graduated from Nova Southern University in Davie Florida. Early on in her dental education, she became deeply involved in patient centered care and won numerous awards including honors for “patient centered care foundations in general dentistry”. Her philosophy on dental care is: “I will always fight for my patients’ rights, and I believe that every member of my community should have access to the best oral health care possible.”

Doctor Sorooshiani  is proud to be serving the city of Tracy and surrounding communities. She loves swimming, hiking and spending time with her family and her dog. In 2021, Dr. Sorooshiani developed a modern dental clinic in Tracy, she named her clinic “Round Hill Dental ”.  Her passion for community well-being drives her approach to dentistry, ensuring that her patients receive the highest level of care.

OurTeam.name: Anna B
OurTeam.bio: Anna will be one of the first people you meet when you call or come into the office. She is bi-lingual and speaks spanish. She started her journey in the dental field 17 years ago. She got certified as an Oral and Maxillofacial surgery assistant in 2013 and was working at an oral surgery office for 14 years. She moved here from the Bay Area in 2021 and loves living here. She has two sons who attend a local high school. Anna enjoys spending time and traveling with her family as well as going to Warriors, Giants and 49ers games!

OurTeam.name: Vanessa A
OurTeam.bio: Vanessa's journey as a dental assistant began in 2013 when she graduated from Heald College in Stockton, California, then certified as a Register Dental Assisting in 2020. She was raised and lives in Tracy. During her free time she enjoys spending time with family & friends. Vanessa is also bi-lingual and speaks Spanish. She loves taking care of her patients and making them feel comfortable is her priority.
